sections.skill: Prove properties of conjugates and moduli

branch.new_demand: Prove and use general identities for conjugates and moduli.

questions.domain: Number & Quantity: The Complex Number System
questions.skill: Prove properties of conjugates and moduli
questions.standard_level: Algebra II. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra II, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: Which argument proves z · z̄ = |z|² for z = a + bi (a and b real)?
questions.prompt_markup: Which argument proves z · z̄ = |z|² for z = a + bi (a and b real)?

choices.text: (a + bi)(a - bi) = a² + b²i², which is |z|² because |z| = √(a² + b²i²).
(a + bi)(a - bi) = a² - b², and |z|² = a² - b².
(a + bi)(a - bi) = a² - b²i² = a² + b², and |z|² = a² + b².
For z = 3 + 4i: (3 + 4i)(3 - 4i) = 25 = 5², so the statement holds.

questions.correct_answer: (a + bi)(a - bi) = a² - b²i² = a² + b², and |z|² = a² + b².
questions.grading_note: Multiply, use i² = -1, and compare with |z| = √(a² + b²). The others forget i² = -1 (and misstate |z|), check one example, or expand with a sign error.

questions.prompt: In the complex plane, what do the modulus and the angle of a complex number represent?
questions.prompt_markup: In the complex plane, what do the modulus and the angle of a complex number represent?

choices.text: The modulus is the sum of the parts a + b; the angle is the ratio of the parts b/a.
The modulus is the distance from 1; the angle is measured from the positive imaginary axis.
The modulus is the real part; the angle is the imaginary part of the number written as a + bi.
The modulus is the distance from 0; the angle is the direction measured from the positive real axis.

questions.correct_answer: The modulus is the distance from 0; the angle is the direction measured from the positive real axis.
questions.grading_note: Polar form describes a point by its distance and direction from the origin.
